title: File:Rice terrace at Ban Mae Klang Luang.jpg
claims: The image shows stepped rice terraces on a hillside at Ban Mae Klang Luang, with a small wooden hut on the left and forest around the fields.

The Commons file identifies Ban Mae Klang Luang in Doi Inthanon National Park, Chiang Mai Province; it shows the village's farmland, not the B1 school gate, aid-station tent, timing mat or race-day crowd.
The author is Voranat Rajchatan; the file is CC BY-SA 4.0; the photograph was taken on 2018-08-12 at 16:20:32; the original is 4,752 x 3,168 pixels and 10,770,656 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 279,145 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author, licence and source.
